reason: This report documents the METHOD by which the UVEK electricity mixes are built — the role of the source datasets (Tab. 1), the nuclear and hydro disaggregation splits (Tab. 2, Tab. 3), pumped-hydro losses (Tab. 4), trade data plausibility (Tab. 5) and the fuel-to-technology mapping (Tab. 6). The mixes themselves appear only as bar charts (Figure 4 production mixes, Figure 5 supply mixes) and the rest as impact results (Figures 7, 8). There is no table giving the per-kWh technology shares of the Hungarian medium-voltage grid, so this dataset's inventory is present only as a result figure, not as readable unit-process raw data.
